headline: Pepper prices today 9.8.2026: Simultaneous decrease of 2,000 VND/kg
summary: Pepper prices fell by 2,000 VND per kg in key growing regions on 9 August. Dak Nong, in Lam Dong, remained highest at 139,000 VND per kg, with the market less buoyant than before.
why: Vietnam is one of the world's largest pepper exporters, so domestic pepper prices influence global spice supply and trade.
